title: fuchsia thymifolia subsp. minimiflora
intro: Fuchsia thymifolia subsp. minimiflora, commonly known as a type of flowering plant, is a species within the evening primrose family (Onagraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation due to its anxiolytic and sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Fuchsia thymifolia subsp. minimiflora include exerting antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
